title: Lateral load test procedures.
officialText: The allowable lateral load of a helical pile shall be verified with load testing in accordance with Section 1808.4. Following the lateral load test, the pile shall be removed by unscrewing and inspected for any deformations to the helices, to verify the structural integrity of the shaft and connections.
